name: serialized-member-written-by-copy-or-untyped-read
description: A data member of a type whose values the program serializes is written where a value typed `any` or `unknown`, a `JSON.parse` result among them, is read as the type by the position it is written in: returned from a function declaring the type as its result, assigned to a variable of the type, or returned from a callback to a call whose result is read as an array of the type. It is written as well where an object literal's spread or an `Object.assign` call copies it from a value whose type has a member of that name. A `satisfies` check reads a value as no type, so a member that only a checked `JSON.parse` result could carry, and that nothing else writes, is reported, and so is a member no copy carries.
